description: Focused reviewer probes. These do not claim full built-in phase-template compliance.

contracts.judge: Focused semantic reviewer probe. Review the learner-visible output against the lesson context for answerability, factual fidelity, grade-appropriate clarity, and independence from hidden or earlier student answers. Ordinary constructed exercise values are allowed when labelled. Do not require any built-in phase heading or item count. Quote the decisive learner-visible wording in each finding.
contracts.solver: Focused answer-correctness probe. Independently solve every item and check every option, accepted answer, key, and feedback against the exact wording. Do not review heading format, item counts, workload, or style. Quote the decisive item wording in each discrepancy.
